recurringPatterns.pattern: Affirm-then-negate couplet as the default paragraph engine, several times per page
instances: The skeleton narrows the timing while leaving the social setting open.
The record shows movement and hardship. They do not establish that drought alone caused the uprising

recurringPatterns.pattern: Each section closes with a flat physical-object cadence line restating the anchor artifact
instances: Below that coast, beyond the chart's measured signs, the bronze cannon lay in the wreck of the Girona off County Antrim.
The roadblock captain named in the Kibuye testimony remains at the checkpoint...

recurringPatterns.pattern: Chapters assembled from 2–5 self-contained case blocks with no transitional argument; new block begins 'At [place]'
instances: At Jericho, permanence altered the practical sequence...
In 1896, the Matopos hills in southern Africa held the final stage of a war

recurringPatterns.pattern: Named counter-argument dispatched with the identical formula 'The claim fails at X' in at least four chapters
instances: The stabilizing claim fails at that point.
The measurement argument fails where improved records are asked to explain away dated bodies and displaced people.

recurringPatterns.pattern: Uniform paragraph architecture: 5-8 declarative sentences of near-identical length
instances: A king's account of rebellion begins with the shape he gives it.

summary: The method has eaten the book: the chapter-1 taxonomy is never invoked again, chapters accumulate rather than argue, chapter 10 delivers more caution instead of synthesis; affirm-then-negate couplets, flat object-image cadence closers, 'the claim fails at X' formula; Pa Demba Road opening restates one undocumented meeting across seven empty paragraphs.
